news.title: Enterprise AI agents keep failing because they forget what they learned
news.summary_raw: RAG architectures are good at one thing: surfacing semantically relevant documents. That's also where they stop.A framework called a decision context graph addresses that gap by giving agents structured memory, time-aware reasoning, and explicit decision logic. Rippletide, a startup in the Neo4j ecosystem, has built one. The key capability: agents that are non-regressive, able to freeze validated sequences of actions and compound on them over time.“The key point you want is non-regressivity
news.summary: Rippletide, a startup in the Neo4j ecosystem, has developed a decision context graph framework for AI agents, enabling them to freeze validated sequences of actions and compound over time, making non-regressive decisions. This addresses a limitation of current RAG architectures, which stop short of enabling agents to remember and build upon their previous actions.>
news.enterprise_use: This news highlights the limitations of current RAG architectures, which may impact IT engineers' ability to implement reliable AI-driven decision-making in their workflows. To stay ahead, Ahmed should monitor startups and research emerging frameworks like Rippletide's decision context graph, which may lead to more robust AI agents.
